name: vibebook-plugin
description: Vibebook Claude Code plugin — digest sessions into chronicles + topics, recall past notes before work. Standalone, no extra CLI required. For cross-device sync, see the vibebook npm CLI (separate package).

plugins.name: vibebook
plugins.description: Run /vibebook to digest your sessions into chronicle + topic. Run /vibebook-recall before starting work to surface past notes that bear on the current task. Atomic cards delegated to memex when installed.
